title: Influence as expected conditional variance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product and contains the constant-one function. For every natural number $n$, every function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and every coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the influence of $f$ at $i$ equals the product-distribution expectation of its conditional variance when only coordinate $i$ is resampled from $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty index set for the Fourier basis with decidable equality
A real basis of functions on $\Omega$, orthonormal for $\pi$ and containing the constant-one function
